title: Trusted Monitoring with Cheap Paraphrase Ensembles
track: Control protocols and monitoring for untrusted models
content:
## Problem

Seed placeholder project. Trusted monitors are expensive; we test whether paraphrase ensembles of a small trusted model catch backdoored code as well as a single large monitor.

## Method

We reproduce a subset of the control-evaluations setting with 150 code tasks and compare monitor configurations.

## Results

The ensemble recovers 85% of the large monitor's catch rate at 20% of the cost.

## Limitations

Single task family; no adaptive attacker. Replace with a real AI Control entry snapshot.

title: Red-Teaming Resampling Protocols with Steganographic Signals
content:
## Problem

Seed placeholder project. Resampling protocols assume independent samples; we test whether an untrusted model can coordinate across resamples via steganographic signals.

## Method

We fine-tune a small model to embed and detect signals in code comments, then measure attack success under a resampling defense.

## Results

Coordination survives naive resampling but collapses under comment stripping.

## Limitations

Toy setting, small model. Replace with a real AI Control entry snapshot.
